red_team.finding: quiet_craft_discipline remains legal: 九地 + star-in-tomb read as craft discipline rather than guarded alliance. Distinguishing test: does the brand's public voice withhold generosity, or slow it down?
Rebutting C001 with centre contention (R018) fails: the centre's contention is intra-centre and its stem lands in the display palace (R047), which supports rather than refutes the alliance reading.

visible_authority (explicit rise-to-throne markers at palaces 3 and 7) is a legal contrast direction. It stays live because palace 7's marker is computed-confirmed while palace 3's is EXPLICIT_UNCONFIRMED.
muted_shell_over_active_core is legal and cheaper to produce than a staged reveal; the difference is only whether the second state is staged or simultaneous.
Rebutting C007 as 'the system is in control' fails: the command axis carries gate pressure and breakage markers, so no control claim survives.
product_only is legal and arguably stronger (star-in-tomb). hands_only survives because the impulse star keeps movement in frame; the two differ in whether a human trace is present at all.
context_first_then_core is legal. The ordering claim is the weakest live claim in the set; it should be presented to the producer as a preference with its phase citation, not as a finding.
ai_led_human_gated is legal: the board's leading star is the tool/learning star. It survives only if a human gate is placed exactly at the instrument/punishment layer.
Rebutting C004 with the circulating bright value (R037) fails: a circulating value is not a product format, and the product format is NO_CHART_SUPPORT regardless.
The rejected claim cannot be re-argued by adding chart support: the traceability requirement is a hard case constraint, and a chart-selected name fails it by construction.
cool_withholding is legal and only differs by degree of warmth; distinguishing test: does a sample line give a reason before an instruction?
layer_led remains legal: the depth deity plus the stored star would let Brief 2 lead with layering instead of the axis inversion.
object_only_ritual_frame is legal and stronger on the stored-star evidence; the two hero directions differ only in whether a human trace appears.
threshold_interior is legal: an interior edge keeps the 'act' visible and is cheaper to scout than a sealed studio.
